item.title: Child Nutrition project targets 30,000 beneficiaries in 2026
item.description: The Child Nutrition and Social Protection (CNSP) Project has entered a new phase of growth and decentralisation, with a clear target to reach 30,000 beneficiaries in 2026. As of the end of 2025, the project had successfully registered 10,812 beneficiaries across its four participating provinces: East New Britain, Simbu, Western, and Madang.
